integrity.anchor_registry_note: The corpus provenance gate verifies each anchor against the file that anchor names and stores no registry-level digest of its own. This digest is recorded so a signature also pins which anchor set was in force.
integrity.verbatim_block_note: The block in section 3 is the file's decoded text with any single trailing newline removed, which is what the markdown fences require. `record_sha256` above is over the raw file bytes and is the digest a signature refers to; this one is over the text as embedded, so a verifier can compare either.

value: Automated AI review performed in a single agent session. It is not organizational independence, not human confirmation, and not a qualified-checker result (master-prompt clause 2.9).
human_approval_status is 'pending' for every artifact covered by this review. No human reviewer signed any of them.
No artifact covered by this review carries production authority or product verification credit.

No penetration test, no exploit, no attack and no exploitability assessment was performed or is claimed by this review or by any artifact it covers. The TARA's own threat descriptions were checked for fabricated vulnerability data and none was found.

Verification performed: (a) every file:line assertion in the real_source_presence fields of SEC-000001..SEC-000005 was spot-checked against the real source and all sampled assertions matched exactly; (b) the TARA was searched for CVE identifiers, CVSS scores and exploit claims - none present, and an explicit 'No exploitability assessment of any kind was performed' statement is present; (c) the TARA declares is_iso_21434_tara=false and lists its own limitations including the absence of damage scenarios, attack-path analysis and TARA review; (d) every artifact was scanned for certification, tool-qualification, human-approval and ASPICE-capability claims - none present.

The file:line check was a spot check of the highest-consequence assertions (ethernet accept and queue hand-off, backlog and receive-timeout constants, UART XOFF/XON gating, CAN dispatch match, TCP initial-sequence-number generator and its seed). It was not an exhaustive check of every line reference in every record, and a residual possibility of an unchecked but incorrect line reference remains.
This review does not assess whether the threat enumeration is complete. Completeness of a TARA is a specialist activity and is not claimed here.

findings.description: No test measure, execution record or verification link of any kind exists for FB2-SAF-SEC-000001, or for SEC-000002..SEC-000005. All five carry verification_status 'not_verified' and all five are absent from both the source and the target sets of any verifies/validates link in the link registry.
